aliases: Thermal & Optical Bi-spectrum Outdoor PoE Network Camera (Bullet)
sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 256x192, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 40 mK; optical: 1/2.7" Progressive Scan CMOS
features: optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 8.0 mm F1.6, 120 dB WDR, 0.0089 lux colour @F1.6
thermal detector: uncooled VOx 256x192, 12 um, NETD < 40 mK, 9.7 mm F1.0, IFOV 1.24 mrad
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/- 8 C (10 points, 10 areas, 1 line)
fire detection, smoking detection, sun-reflection filter
VCA: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exit with human/vehicle filtering
IR up to 30 m and white light up to 30 m; strobe + audible alarm (custom voice alerts)

home_assistant.notes: Uses Hikvision protocol (ISAPI / ONVIF Profile S, G). Thermal and optical are exposed as separate channels.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Hikvision' profile. Most Annke cameras use Hikvision protocol.

release_notes: Specs per official Annke product page (Thermal & Optical Bi-spectrum Outdoor PoE Network Camera, Bullet variant I81HZ) and the DS-2TD2628-10/QA specification PDF it links. Hikvision-OEM unit but with a 4 MP (2688x1520) optical channel, unlike Hikvision's 2 MP DS-2TD2628-10. Resolution field = thermal module per dataset convention. Operating temperature not stated. The page's Turret variant (I81DY) has no separate specifications and was not recorded.
